$comment: Every setting of Explorer Extras, declared once. build.py writes the Windhawk settings block and the C++ settings table from it. See SPEC-settings-shell.md.

settings.name: Enable Columns
settings.description: Adds Columns to the View menu. Off removes it.

settings.name: Open new windows in Columns
settings.description: New Explorer windows open in Columns if it was your last layout. Picking another layout turns this off.

settings.name: Keep columns after choosing a file
settings.description: Columns to the right stay, dimmed, when you choose a file or several items. Off closes them.

settings.name: Keyboard on group headers
settings.description: Arrow keys reach group headers. Left, Right and Enter collapse and expand them.

settings.name: Double-click empty space to go up
settings.description: Goes up one folder. In the first column, the parent folder is added in front.

settings.name: Sidebar sets the first column
settings.description: Clicking Home, Gallery, OneDrive or a pinned folder in the navigation pane makes it the first column. Off, the columns follow it like any other navigation. The tree (This PC, drives, Network) always follows the columns.

settings.name: Folders first
settings.description: Folders are listed before files in each column, whatever the sort.

settings.name: Desktop column shows real items only
settings.description: Hides virtual items (This PC, Recycle Bin, Control Panel…) from the Desktop column.

settings.name: Minimum column width
settings.description: Columns fit their longest name, but not below this width (in pixels).

settings.name: Maximum column width
settings.description: Columns fit their longest name up to this width (in pixels). Longer names are shortened.

settings.name: Shift + double-click to even widths
settings.description: Shift + double-click a column border gives all columns the same width. They stay so until a border is double-clicked alone.

settings.name: Show the focus outline
settings.description: Draws an outline around the item under the keyboard cursor. The selection highlight always shows.

settings.name: Panel background
settings.description: Explorer uses its own file list colour. Theme uses the standard dark or light colour.

settings.name: Accent badge on the path chevron
settings.description: The chevron of the folder you came from sits in a round accent badge, instead of a muted one.

settings.name: Notice in an empty column, and while one loads
settings.description: A muted line in the column when the folder is empty, and a small spinner with Loading when a folder takes a moment to open.

settings.name: Alternate row shading
settings.description: Every other row is a shade apart, to follow a line across a wide column.

settings.name: Remember sort and grouping
settings.description: Each folder keeps its own sort and grouping. When off, every column uses the first folder’s.

settings.name: Remember column widths
settings.description: A column you resize reopens at that width.

settings.name: Remember Columns per folder
settings.description: Each folder remembers whether it was left in Columns. Opening it turns Columns on or off to match.

settings.name: Details pane
settings.description: Replaces Explorer’s Details and Preview panes with one pane that holds a preview and the details of what is selected.

settings.name: Preview pane opens this pane
settings.description: When Explorer’s Preview pane is turned on (Alt+P or the View menu), this pane opens in its place.

settings.name: Animate the pane
settings.description: The content slides and fades in when the selection changes.

settings.name: Open previews by themselves
settings.description: When off, a button on the preview opens it, and switches back to the thumbnail.

settings.name: Count folder sizes by itself
settings.description: A folder’s size, contents and types are counted when it is selected, which can use some CPU on a slow computer. Off, a button counts them when you ask.

settings.name: Preview documents and code
settings.description: Shows PDF, text, Markdown and Office files in the pane.

settings.name: Preview images
settings.description: Shows pictures at full size in the pane, with zoom and pan.

settings.name: Preview video and sound
settings.description: Plays video and sound files in the pane.

settings.name: Show labels
settings.description: Labels are coloured dots on files and folders, drawn in File Explorer and in Columns. They are kept in the file itself (they stay there if the mod is removed) and need an NTFS drive. Off by default.

settings.name: Sort and group by tags
settings.description: Adds the labels to Explorer’s own Tags property, so Sort by, Group by and the Tags column use them. The tags a file already has are kept. Takes effect when a folder is shown again.

settings.name: Name of the neutral gray
settings.description: What this colour means to you. It is shown for tags that have no name of their own, and it stays on this PC.

settings.name: Name of colour 2
settings.description: What this colour means to you. It is shown for tags that have no name of their own, and it stays on this PC.

settings.name: Name of colour 3
settings.description: What this colour means to you. It is shown for tags that have no name of their own, and it stays on this PC.

settings.name: Name of colour 4
settings.description: What this colour means to you. It is shown for tags that have no name of their own, and it stays on this PC.

settings.name: Name of colour 5
settings.description: What this colour means to you. It is shown for tags that have no name of their own, and it stays on this PC.

settings.name: Name of colour 6
settings.description: What this colour means to you. It is shown for tags that have no name of their own, and it stays on this PC.

settings.name: Name of colour 7
settings.description: What this colour means to you. It is shown for tags that have no name of their own, and it stays on this PC.

settings.name: Name of colour 8
settings.description: What this colour means to you. It is shown for tags that have no name of their own, and it stays on this PC.

settings.name: Replace the navigation pane
settings.description: Covers Explorer’s navigation pane with a sidebar of Favorites, Locations and Tags. Off leaves the navigation pane as it is.

settings.name: Highlight section headers on hover
settings.description: Gives the Favorites, Locations and Tags headers a background while the pointer is over them. The chevron and the … button have their own.

settings.name: Let the Drives and devices group collapse
settings.description: Adds a chevron to the group so it can be closed. Off keeps it always open, and a click on its row opens This PC.

settings.name: List drives without a group
settings.description: Puts the drives, OneDrive and phones straight in Locations instead of under Drives and devices.

settings.name: Keep the keyboard in the sidebar after a click
settings.description: When on, the arrows, Enter, Delete (unpin a favorite), F2 (rename a tag) and Ctrl+arrows (move a favorite or tag) work on the row you clicked. When off, the keyboard goes back to the file area, so the arrow keys keep moving through the columns.

settings.name: Show how many files each tag has
settings.description: A muted number at the right of each tag row in the sidebar.

settings.name: Show free space under each drive
settings.description: A thin bar along the bottom of a drive's row that shows how full it is. It does not change the row's size.

settings.name: Eject button on removable drives
settings.description: A small button at the right of a removable drive's row, shown while the pointer is over it.

options.label: My order (drag a tag to move it)

settings.name: Order of the tags in the sidebar
settings.description: Recent puts the tag you used last on top. My order keeps the order you give by dragging a tag row.

settings.name: Tags shown in the sidebar
settings.description: The most recently used tags the sidebar lists, View all shows the others. -1 lists every tag.

settings.name: Maximum items per column
settings.description: A column lists at most this many items. A bigger folder shows the first ones in the sort order.

settings.name: Largest document to preview (MB)
settings.description: Bigger PDFs and Office files keep the thumbnail.

settings.name: Largest image to open at once (megapixels)
settings.description: Bigger pictures wait for a click on the card's button.
